instruction: Capture a screenshot of the current video frame and save it as 'interstellar.png' on the Desktop.

parameters.window_name: Interstellar Movie - Interstellar Movie - Official Trailer - VLC media player

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires capturing a screenshot from VLC and saving it as 'interstellar.png' on Desktop. Evaluator checks: (1) file exists, (2) file is a valid PNG image, (3) file size is reasonable (10KB-50MB). This uses state-based evaluation without external ground truth.
